blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 50 to 46, and it took 7.5% of the city’s 240 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 43 to 28, and it took 9.3% of the city’s 375 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Sunnyside Park for detached houses in June (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, August, September (a sellers’ best bet).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Sunnyside Park Surrey than in June?
faq.a: Between June 2026 and September 2026, listings of houses fell from 50 to 46 and condos and townhomes fell from 43 to 28 in Sunnyside Park Surrey.

faq.q: How big is Sunnyside Park Surrey compared with the rest of South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: In September 2026, Sunnyside Park Surrey held 7.7% of the 600 houses listed in South Surrey and White Rock and 4.7% of the 593 condos and townhomes listed in South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Sunnyside Park Surrey from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 18 houses and 35 condos and townhomes sold in Sunnyside Park Surrey over those 4 months.
